{{Short description|Swedish physicist}}
'''Olle Inganäs''' (born 1951), is a [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[Professor]] of [[Biomolecular]] and [[Organic electronics|Organic Electronics]] at [[Linköping University]], [[Sweden]].

Professor Inganäs received his doctorate in 1984 from [[Linköping University]].<ref>Inganäs, O. 1984. [http://libris.kb.se/bib/7638484 ''Photoelectrochemistry and electronic properties of some organic solids'']. PhD Thesis, Linköping University, Sweden.</ref>

His research interests are in [[polymer]] [[optoelectronics]] and [[bioelectronics]], [[Conjugated system|conjugated]] [[polymer physics]] and [[polymer]] [[electrochemistry]].<ref>[https://cms.ifm.liu.se/applphys/biorgel/research/ Research interests of Prof. Inganäs's group.]</ref>

==Awards==
* Member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]], 2006.<ref>[http://www.kva.se/sv/Nyheter/2008/Nya-ledamoter-invalda-i-akademien/ Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences: New members elected into the academy], press release 2006-11-13</ref>
* [[Göran Gustafsson Prize]], [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]], 1997.<ref>[http://www.kva.se/sv/pressrum/pressmeddelanden-2000-1991/Goran-Gustafssonpristagare-1998-Tre-kvinnor-bland-landets-framsta-forskare/ Press release from the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]</ref>
